issueBodies.117:
## Outcome
Inspect cells read clearly over the image: when a cross-section cut is active, the cut face shows a crisp contrasting outline separate from an optional faint interior fill. With no cut, cells render normally with no rim/fill contrast (same shader path and default fill as `main`).

## Visual acceptance
Before/after screenshots on Pyxa small or colon A2 (mosaic visible): **uncut** (no contrasting rims; after matches main) and **Z-cut through cells** (rim on the cut face; after differs from main), plus Playwright snapshots for uncut Top and Z-cut Side in the toy harness.

### Problem
In the Inspect cube, cell boundaries are hard to read: a cell's edge and interior are drawn in the same colour, so neighbouring cells blur together over the image.

**History:**
- **v1.1.0:** cell-boundary voxels were drawn as a separate outline in a shared orange at alpha 0.5, with clear interiors.
- **#58:** changed this to category-coloured shells at 0.6.
- **#71:** added per-cell hues plus a 0.35 interior fill.
- **#83:** faded the label layer to `cellAlpha: 0.4` (`DEFAULT_RENDER` in `frontend/src/widgets/volume-cube/palettes.ts`) and removed the fill controls.

**Direction (agreed with Clarence):** contrasting outlines only where a **Z-cut or crop face** crosses a cell; faint optional fill inside the cut volume; **no outline work when the cut is open** (full stack); uncut rendering matches `main`.

## Acceptance
- [ ] With **no active cut** (full X/Y/Z span), cells render uniformly from category/instance/expression colouring at the Labels fill opacity (`cellAlpha` default **0.4**, same as `main`). **No** contrasting rim or interior/outline split. **Uncut** uses the main single-plane LUT shader variant.
- [ ] With an **active cut** (narrowed X, Y, or Z), voxels on the **cut plane** that bound a cell show a **contrasting outline at full opacity** (shared orange for category cells, or near-white/near-black from luminance for instances). Outline colour contrasts with image and fill.
- [ ] **Interior fill on the cut** is separate and optional (Fill slider; default matches main when uncut). Colouring modes and focus dimming unchanged.
- [ ] Adjust panel: **Cut outline** on/off and **Fill** opacity; no extra chrome.
- [ ] No regression in Inspect performance vs `main` when uncut (main shader variant; orbit within **5%**). With cut + outlines, orbit overhead **under 15%** vs main at the same cut.
- [ ] **Playwright**: snapshot **uncut Top** (no rims) and **Z-cut Side** (rims on cut face); pixel check that toggling cut outlines off changes the cut view.
- [ ] PR includes paired before (`main`) / after (branch) Pyxa or colon shots: uncut + Z-cut, mosaic visible; Z-cut after shows rims (pixel diff vs main).
